quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #18
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 18

questions.question: Lines that divide traffic moving in opposite directions are ____.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines divide traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: Crossbuck signs indicate:
questions.explanation: Crossbuck signs warn drivers about railroad crossings. You must yield to trains and never try to race across the tracks.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should:

options.text: Signal as you start to move into the next lane
Signal at least 500 feet before changing lanes on residential streets

questions.explanation: Cars and motorcycles can hide in your blind spot. Look over your shoulder before changing lanes. Signal 100 feet before turning on residential streets. Signal five seconds in advance on freeways.

questions.question: When driving on wet pavement, remember:

options.text: The road is extra slippery right after rain starts

questions.explanation: Wet roads are very slippery, especially right after it rains. Water mixes with oil and dirt on the road. Slow down in heavy rain or when water is on the road to keep your tires from sliding.

questions.question: A diamond-shaped sign:

options.text: Warns of existing or possible hazards
Alerts drivers to public recreation areas
Alerts drivers to upcoming food and gas locations

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns of existing or possible hazards
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards ahead. These signs are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: You may drink alcohol in a vehicle on a public highway:

options.text: If you are riding in the back seat
If you are riding in the back of a pickup truck

questions.explanation: It is illegal to consume or have open alcohol in a vehicle on any public road. This applies to all passengers and seats.

questions.question: ____ greatly increase stopping distance and crash severity.
questions.explanation: High speeds increase stopping distance and make crashes more severe. The faster you drive, the harder the impact if you crash.

questions.question: When a driver is turning and a pedestrian is crossing without a traffic light, who must yield?
questions.explanation: Drivers must yield to pedestrians crossing at any intersection, whether or not there is a traffic light or crosswalk.

questions.question: Two solid white lines across a traffic lane mark a crosswalk. As a driver, you should know:

options.text: Drivers have the right-of-way over pedestrians in crosswalks
Pedestrians in crosswalks have the right-of-way
No one has the right-of-way in a crosswalk
Pedestrians must stay out of the way of traffic

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrians in crosswalks have the right-of-way
questions.explanation: Crosswalk lines show where pedestrians should cross. You must always stop for pedestrians in a crosswalk.

questions.question: Which of these affect how alcohol influences a person?

options.text: How much food is in the stomach

questions.explanation: Blood alcohol content depends on how much you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your weight. Eating slows alcohol absorption but does not prevent impairment from drinking too much.

questions.question: Your power steering stops working while you are driving. What should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn and turn off the engine.
Turn on your hazard lights and prepare for impact.
Steer firmly, slow down, move to a safe area, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steer firmly, slow down, move to a safe area, and stop.
questions.explanation: When power steering fails, you need to steer with more force. Slow down and pull to a safe area to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn you about hazards ahead. This sign means a traffic light is coming. Be ready to stop for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What usually causes hydroplaning?
questions.explanation: When you drive fast, your tires cannot clear water from the road. They lose grip and slide on the water. This is called hydroplaning.

questions.question: How can you avoid hitting vehicles in your blind spots?

options.text: Turn your head and look over your shoulder before changing lanes.
Adjust your rearview mirrors every few minutes.
Honk your horn before turning or changing lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look over your shoulder before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Before you turn or change lanes, look over your shoulder to check your blind spot. Do not rely only on your mirrors.

questions.question: Which drugs can affect your driving ability?
questions.explanation: Many types of drugs can impair your driving. This includes illegal drugs and over-the-counter or prescription medications. Driving while impaired by any drug is against the law.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and oncoming traffic go first. Only stop if you need to.

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic light means what color light comes next?
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means a steady red light will appear next.

questions.question: Traffic signals at an intersection are not working due to a power outage. What should you do?

options.text: Park off the road and wait for power to return.
Use hand signals to show other drivers what you plan to do.
Turn on hazard lights and drive through without stopping.
Treat it like a four-way stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a four-way stop.
questions.explanation: When a traffic light is not working, treat the intersection as a four-way stop. Yield to other drivers the same way you would at a four-way stop. Then go through carefully when it is your turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a Keep Right sign. An island, median, or barrier is ahead. Stay on the side shown by the arrow.

questions.question: Highway signs that show dangerous conditions are called:
questions.explanation: Warning signs tell drivers about hazards ahead. Always obey warning signs. Ignoring them can cause accidents.

questions.question: What helps a person recover from drinking alcohol?
questions.explanation: Only time allows the body to get over alcohol's effects.

questions.question: Regulatory signs are usually ____ and must always be obeyed.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs control traffic movement. They are usually white with black markings. Drivers must always obey them.

questions.question: To check your blind spot before changing lanes:

options.text: Look into the left side mirror.
Look into the right side mirror.
Look over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move.
questions.explanation: Look over your shoulder toward the direction you want to move to check your blind spot.

questions.question: When driving in rain, you must:
questions.explanation: Use your low beam headlights when it is raining.
